name: tlm
description: Local command-line copilot that suggests and explains shell commands using open models served by Ollama, with no API key.
whatItDoes: Suggests a command for a described goal, explains what an existing command does, and answers questions with optional file context. It suits developers who want terminal help that stays on their machine.
howItWorks: A Go binary detects the current shell and sends prompts to a local Ollama instance. Suggest, explain and ask subcommands each use their own prompt style, and the user confirms before a suggested command runs.
